attributes.name: circpoints
attributes.digest: Circumference points
attributes.description: The number of circumference points to render for each cylindrical slice. For example, a value of 1 will render a line, a value of 2 will render a planar area, a value of 3 will render the geometry using triangular prisms, etc.
